question: Why does winner-takes-all voting end with just two big parties?
answer: With winner-takes-all voting, sixty voters each cast one vote and the most votes takes all. Small parties become spoilers, so voters leave them. Only two big parties remain.
move: Winner-takes-all turns small parties into spoilers, so voters leave them and two parties remain.
